summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0x hex identifiers and object-property-dispatch string literals) and, when npm install runs the preinstall hook, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs that Bun binary against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled JavaScript file (starts with `// @bun @bun-cjs`) consisting entirely of an obfuscated numeric string-array decoder — not human-readable, not part of any documented eslint-config behavior. The stated purpose of the package is an eslint TypeScript/React configuration, which does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or install-time execution of a bundled opaque payload. The combination — obfuscated preinstall script, alternate-runtime download, and execution of an obfuscated 727KB blob under that runtime — is an install-time-RCE dropper that runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
